context: Adds sort and minimum-price filtering to the public products search endpoint.
explanation: Two new user-controlled inputs are interpolated directly into raw SQL: params[:sort] is spliced into order(...) and params[:min_price] into a where("price >= #{...}") string, alongside an existing ILIKE clause that was also switched from a bind parameter to string interpolation. Any of these lets an attacker inject arbitrary SQL (e.g. via q, sort, or min_price) to exfiltrate data or break out of the query. Fix: use bind parameters (where("price >= ?", params[:min_price])) and a safe allowlist for the sort column.
